## Buildings {#sec-buildings}

### Corporation camps

Both corporations build from the same set, each in its own colors. Grubstake's turret fires bullets, and every
second turret it builds is a scrap cannon.

| Building | Health (Kessler-Hayashi) | Health (Grubstake) | What it does |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| Lander | 12,000 | 12,000 | The center of a faction base. Destroying it destroys the base. |
| Uplink | 6,000 | 6,000 | A faction's headquarters. Destroying it makes the faction withdraw. |
| Generator | 400 | 400 |  |
| Pylon | 100 | 100 |  |
| Drill | 300 | 300 |  |
| Ore bin | 200 | 200 |  |
| Fabricator | 350 | 350 |  |
| Laser turret | 1,000 | 400 |  |
| Wall | 450 | 225 |  |
| Gate | 350 | 350 |  |
| Flamethrower turret | 1,400 | 1,400 |  |
| Mine | 15 | 15 |  |
| Mortar | 800 | 800 |  |
| Howitzer (deployed) | 1,200 | 1,200 |  |
| Radar | 250 | 250 |  |
| Depot | 1,000 | 1,000 |  |
| Launch pad | 2,000 | 2,000 |  |

### Kessler-Hayashi only

| Building | Health | What it does |
|:--|--:|:--|
| Optics lab | 600 |  |
| Armory | 600 |  |
| Siege works | 600 |  |
| Kessler-Hayashi jamming mast | 1,500 | Destroys construction and logistic robots in range. |
| Invoice post | 350 | Bills you for biter attacks caused by your pollution. Paying in full with circuits, modules or steel buys a truce of 10 to 60 minutes. |

Each research lab advances one branch of Kessler-Hayashi's research, and only while it stands.

### Grubstake only

| Building | Health | What it does |
|:--|--:|:--|
| Pacifier antenna | 1,500 | Keeps biters from attacking Grubstake. Drops pheromone glands, and sometimes a pacifier crystal. |
| Grubstake yard | 600 | Stores what Grubstake has stolen. Drops its contents when destroyed. |
| Grubstake claim stake | 150 | Grubstake claims the ore here when the lamp runs out, unless the ore is being mined or the stake is destroyed. |
| Claim jumper rig | 1,200 | Digs a tunnel toward your base for a Grubstake raiding crew. |
| Power tap | 150 | Draws power from your electric network. |

### Synthexis

| Building | Health | What it does |
|:--|--:|:--|
| Synthexis incubator | 350 | A biter spawner taken over by Synthexis. Drops pheromone glands. |
| Synthexis biochamber | 300 | Feeds a Synthexis incubator so it can breed. |
| Synthexis clinic | 1,500 | Makes Synthexis biters stronger. Without it, only small and medium biters are bred. |
| Synthexis heating tower | 500 |  |
| Synthexis tumor | 400 | Spreads Synthexis creep around it. Nothing can be built on creep. |
| Synthexis worm | 500 |  |
| Synthexis lamp | 100 |  |

### Yours

| Building | Health | What it does |
|:--|--:|:--|
| Barracks | 350 | Trains units from orders. |
| Rally beacon | 120 | Gathers units and gives them orders by signal. |
| Command relay | 250 | Lets you command 10 more units while powered. Research raises how many relays count. |
| Muster point | 350 | Turns unit orders into units and sends them to the nearest rally beacon. |
| Threat scanner | 120 | Outputs the number of faction units and biters within 64 tiles, by type. |
| Mortar | 800 | Short-range artillery that fires mortar shells. |
| Strip drill | 300 | Mines twice as fast as an electric mining drill and depletes ore at half the rate. |
| Border stake | 200 | Sets a border with the nearest Kessler-Hayashi base. Its perimeter stops at the stake. |
| Trade post | 350 | Grubstake collects the items placed here in exchange for a truce. |
| Claim marker | 300 | Grubstake leaves your buildings within 40 tiles alone. |
| Pact breaker | 200 | Jams Grubstake's pact with the biters for 3 minutes. Works only inside a Grubstake claim. |
| Pheromone bait | 100 | Makes nearby biters attack whatever is around it. |
| Field dome | 1,200 | Stops enemy artillery shells within its radius while powered. Goes down for a time after too many hits. |
| Orbital cannon | 3,000 | Charges a strike from a shell and thruster fuel, up to 2, one each 3 minutes. Built at a platform's edge, barrel over the void. |
| Targeting array | 400 | Lets the cannons of its platform fire on Nauvis while the platform is stopped there. |
